text:
Sophia: Heads-up: nova13b int8 run shows structured-output regressions. 3/50 golden JSON tasks failed strict parse.
Ana: Ugh. Example?
Sophia:
```
EXPECTED:
{
  "action": "create_ticket",
  "args": {
    "title": "Crash on save",
    "priority": "high"
  }
}
INT8_OUTPUT:
{
  "action": "create_ticket",
  "args": "title: Crash on save, priority: high"
}
```
Ana: Looks like args became a flattened string. Could be tokenizer quoting or decode path.
Mike: Might also be kernel fallback in int8 decoder losing structural tokens. Any runtime fallbacks in logs? :eyes:
Sophia: Yes, saw ~7 kernel fallbacks for those requests. Will paste logs to the ticket. Quick repro command: 
```bash
python eval.py --model nova13b-int8 --golden tests/structured_gold.json --filter=tool_call --strict-json
```
Raj: Two immediate checks: 1) tokenizer version used for int8 run (tokenizer-v2?) 2) sampling/temperature parity between fp16 and int8 runs.
Mike: We pushed a tokenizer tweak last week changing how punctuation inside braces splits. That could explain it.
label-bot: Automated sanity-check: 45 items flagged as ambiguous-structure; reassigning to @Jules (priority: high).
Jules: I got the reassign. Will start re-annotating flagged items tomorrow. ETA ~48h for first pass.
Ana: Labelling rule: prefer native JSON structures (objects/arrays) over stringified args. If ambiguous, mark 'needs-dev-review'.
Sophia: Also need ~200 more nested/edge structured cases in golden set (nested arrays, mixed-type args, unicode in keys).
Mike: I can generate candidate prompts by perturbing existing prompts + unicode injection. Will output to review bucket. Script: `scripts/sample_structured_candidates.py --min-nested 2 --unicode-weight 0.25 --out /tmp/struct_cands.jsonl`
Raj: When we re-run evals, use strict-json pass rate >=98% and structural-levenshtein <=0.03 as acceptance thresholds. Run both strict and structural metrics.
Mike: Will also run a dedicated canary on our Dedicated pool with tag `qcanary/novaint8`. Command: 
```bash
redwood deploy canary --pool dedicated-small --model nova13b-int8 --tag qcanary/novaint8 --eval tests/structured_gold.json --requests 5000
```
Jules: For re-annotation, share sampling script and prioritization: nested fields, escaped quotes, and unicode keys first.
Mike: Dropping sampling command above and will create review PR with candidates.
Sophia: Action items: Mike -> generate candidates + run canary (ETA today). Jules -> re-annotate 45 flagged items (start tomorrow). Sophia -> open golden-patch PR with ~200 labeled cases once Jules finishes. Ana -> audit annotation guidance and do a quick sweep. Raj -> prepare rollback plan (revert tokenizer change) and micro-finetune plan (1k structured examples) in case canary fails.
Ana: If we need micro-fine-tune, prefer low-step, replay on dedicated only and measure overfitting on open tasks.
Sophia: Cool. Ill attach kernel fallback logs and failing IDs to the PR. Ping here when canary finishes. :thumbsup:
